suggestions.title: Manually inspect high-risk patch proposals
suggestions.notes: Do not apply high-risk patches through the comfort of optimism. Optimism has broken enough builds.

suggestions.title: Review large files for possible splitting
suggestions.evidence: Largest indexed file: data/project_index.json with 4465 lines.
suggestions.notes: Large files are harder for local models to patch safely and easier for humans to ruin. Humanity adapts by making smaller messes.

suggestions.title: Review proposed patches waiting for approval
suggestions.notes: Review the diff before applying. Future-you deserves fewer surprises, allegedly.

suggestions.title: Run a test workflow for recently applied patches
suggestions.evidence: There are 4 applied patch(es). Latest applied: patch_20260618_095713_conscious_agent-memory-py
suggestions.notes: An applied patch without a test report is just a guess wearing a helmet.

suggestions.title: Review dense modules for documentation clarity
suggestions.evidence: Dense Python files found: conscious_agent/api_server.py, conscious_agent/approval_manager.py, conscious_agent/autonomous_dev_cycle.py, conscious_agent/chat_action_router.py, conscious_agent/code_reviewer.py, conscious_agent/command_runner.py
suggestions.notes: This is advisory. Do not add docstrings everywhere just to appease the machine goblin.

suggestions.title: Monitor memory growth
suggestions.notes: Memory growth is expected, but future compaction will keep prompts smaller and cheaper.
